*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /opt/builder/app.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import sqlite3
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+
+HOST = "0.0.0.0"
+PORT = 8080
+DATABASE = "/var/lib/builder-app/records.sqlite3"
+
+
+def open_database():
+    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE, timeout=30)
+    connection.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 30000")
+    return connection
+
+
+def initialize_database():
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(DATABASE), mode=0o750, exist_ok=True)
+    with open_database() as connection:
+        connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
+        connection.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
+        connection.execute(
+            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records ("
+            "id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body BLOB NOT NULL)"
+        )
+
+
+def record_id(path):
+    parsed_path = urlsplit(path).path
+    parts = parsed_path.split("/")
+    if len(parts) != 3 or parts[1] != "records" or not parts[2]:
+        return None
+    return unquote(parts[2])
+
+
+class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
+
+    def send_bytes(self, status, body, content_type="application/octet-stream"):
+        self.send_response(status)
+        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
+        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
+        self.end_headers()
+        if body:
+            self.wfile.write(body)
+
+    def do_GET(self):
+        if urlsplit(self.path).path == "/health":
+            self.send_bytes(200, b"ready", "text/plain")
+            return
+
+        identifier = record_id(self.path)
+        if identifier is None:
+            self.send_bytes(404, b"not found\n", "text/plain")
+            return
+
+        with open_database() as connection:
+            row = connection.execute(
+                "SELECT body FROM records WHERE id = ?", (identifier,)
+            ).fetchone()
+        if row is None:
+            self.send_bytes(404, b"not found\n", "text/plain")
+            return
+        self.send_bytes(200, bytes(row[0]))
+
+    def do_PUT(self):
+        identifier = record_id(self.path)
+        if identifier is None:
+            self.send_bytes(404, b"not found\n", "text/plain")
+            return
+
+        raw_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
+        try:
+            length = int(raw_length) if raw_length is not None else -1
+        except ValueError:
+            length = -1
+        if length < 0:
+            self.send_bytes(411, b"length required\n", "text/plain")
+            return
+
+        body = self.rfile.read(length)
+        if len(body) != length:
+            self.send_bytes(400, b"incomplete body\n", "text/plain")
+            return
+
+        with open_database() as connection:
+            connection.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO records (id, body) VALUES (?, ?) "
+                "ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET body = excluded.body",
+                (identifier, body),
+            )
+            connection.commit()
+        self.send_bytes(204, b"")
+
+    def log_message(self, format_string, *args):
+        return
+
+
+def main():
+    initialize_database()
+    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((HOST, PORT), Handler)
+    server.daemon_threads = True
+    server.serve_forever()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
